name: Bacon-Cheddar Beer Dip with Pretzel Bun Bread Sticks & Apple Slices

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium yellow onion
2 clove garlic

instructions.primary_message: When the bacon is done, return skillet (with about 1 tablespoon of drippings) to medium heat.  Add onion, garlic, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is soft, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a 4-quart slow cooker insert.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coarsely grate cream cheese, cheddar, and Monterey Jack, then add to the insert with the onion along with the beer. Cover and cook on high, stirring every 10-15 minutes, until warmed through and combined, 40-50 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (227 g) block cream cheese
1 (227 g) block cheddar cheese
1 (227 g) block Monterey Jack cheese
1 ½ cups pilsner or lager-style beer

instructions.primary_message: Split buns in half then cut lengthwise into 1-inch wide strips. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and toast, turning halfway through, until the breadsticks are golden and crisp, 10-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the breadsticks are toasting, wash, dry, trim, and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Set aside.
Wash, dry, quarter, and core apples; slice into wedges.
When the cheese dip is done, add half of the crispy bacon and green onions, then stir to combine. (Reserve the remaining bacon and green onions for the next step.)
Transfer cheese dip to a serving dish and top with remaining crispy bacon and green onions. Serve with breadsticks and apple wedges for dipping. Enjoy!
